claims.title: Certify a restricted star-model energy and explicit cat beyond a slow local sampler

quoted_fields.interface: The producer supplies a deterministic two-sector inverse-excitation certificate for energy and cat-state fidelity in an inhomogeneous transverse-field star with fixed positive couplings. The reported1025-spin instance has eigenvalue width<8.87e-6 and squared cat overlap>.9999927 despite exponentially slow local guide dynamics. Separate rate, local-state and oracle results preserve their distinct contraction/access assumptions.
quoted_fields.failure: Completed visible producer result for a restricted inhomogeneous transverse-field STAR with analytically solved independent conditional baths and exactly known two sectors. Producer reports a separate completed internal mathematical review of the star/symmetry/preparation argument and independent moment/circuit checks; the actual review/proof/code/data attachments are not supplied in this specifically released visible-only intake, so no acquired version-bound review overlay is fabricated. Companion rate/local/oracle results retain their own scopes and do not inherit the star review. All P3 no-upload/no-export/no-repackaging/no-alternate-transfer restrictions persist. O(n) scalar work is not O(n) bit-time, analytic sectors are not freely learned, the local chain bottleneck is not intrinsic sampling hardness, and fidelity requires the separate symmetry/leakage argument rather than a narrow energy interval. No new tractability class, matched best-method runtime advantage, physical experiment, protected cat or robust symmetry-breaking tolerance is established.
